name: First Flight
author: bootra
description: Play a young witch on her first flight: soar through the skies collecting rings and speed-ups as fast as you can. Arrows to fly, X to speed up, Z to slow down.

descriptions.en: Play a young witch on her first flight: soar through the skies collecting rings and speed-ups as fast as you can. Arrows to fly, X to speed up, Z to slow down.
descriptions.it: Sei una giovane strega al primo volo: sfreccia nel cielo raccogliendo anelli e bonus di velocità il più in fretta possibile. Frecce per volare, X accelera, Z rallenta.
